name: jul-decision-minicpm5-2b
context_scaling: Inherited unchanged from openbmb/MiniCPM5-2B (config.json max_position_embeddings 131072). This derivative does not publish a context-extension recipe of its own.
attention_variant: GQA, 16 query heads and 2 kv heads
notes: ADDED 2026-10-28. A finetune of openbmb/MiniCPM5-2B, not a new base model: same config.json, same 2.517 parameters (identical tensor set). Recorded as a contender because it publishes benchmark evidence against its own base; the evidence rows below are card-sourced and marked vendor_claim. Licence apache-2.0, repo created 2026-09-22.

benchmarks.name: jev-bench all types (300 q)
benchmarks.config: Card 'Results' table, row 'MiniCPM5-2B, untrained (jul vectors)' 0.630 vs 'jul-decision-minicpm5-2b v2' 0.680; printed as a fraction, scaled x100. 300 hand-written questions, 100 per type, PyTorch on A10G, decontaminated by 8-gram+embedding filters. Card states 95% intervals about +/-9 points per type (n=100) - the all-types gain sits inside that interval.
